name: fractions
description: Excel's FV, PV, PMT, NPER, RATE, XNPV and XIRR, on random cases and the edge cases in scripts/excel_edge_cases.py.

provenance.method: A second implementation of each definition in exact fractions. Irrational values are bounded from Python's correctly rounded decimal ln and exp, widened well past their rounding, with the precision raised until the bounds settle every value written.
